# Reproducing this report

From a fresh clone:

```bash
make all   # data -> models -> tests -> lint -> prose-number check -> render
```

The rendered book is published by `.github/workflows/publish.yml` on every
push to `main`, so the public version always matches the committed code.

## Package versions

`sessionInfo()` below records what was used; it does not let anyone get the
same versions back. For that, pin packages with `renv`: run
`renv::init()` once, commit `renv.lock`, and collaborators run
`renv::restore()`. (Pinning is left as a first step for your own project,
because a lockfile should be created on the machine that does the work.)

## Software environment at render time

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
sessionInfo()
```
